title: Qurna, the Marshes & Great Ziggurat of Ur
full_text:
Qurna, Chibayesh Marshlands & The Ancient City of Ur At 05:00 AM Timing can vary depending on the sunrise time at the date of the tour, we begin our journey by heading to Qurna (approx. 1.5 hours), the legendary meeting point of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers.
Here, we will explore the Tree of Adam, an ancient holy tree mentioned in biblical traditions.
We then drive to Chibayesh (approx. 1 hour) for an authentic Marshland experience.
You will enjoy a local breakfast in a traditional mud house with a local family, followed by a boat tour through the floating villages of the Ahwar (a UNESCO World Heritage site).
You will witness the unique ecosystem of reeds, water buffaloes, and migratory birds, and hear fascinating stories from the Al-Madan people who have adapted to life on the water for centuries.
After the marshland tour, we drive to the historical City of Ur (approx. 1.5 hours).
You will visit the Great Ziggurat of Ur, the former capital of Mesopotamia.
The tour includes the House of Prophet Abraham, Shulgi Palace, and the oldest known arch at the entrance of the Dub-Lal-Makh Temple.
We will stay to witness one of the most beautiful sunsets over the Sumerian ruins.
